resolved_intents.intent: Get entered tell your experience text value

missing_methods.intent: Assert tell your experience text is truncated to 2000 characters
missing_methods.detailed_requirements: This method should: 1) Retrieve the current text from the feedback text field using get_entered_text(). 2) Calculate the actual length of the entered text. 3) Assert that the length does not exceed the expected_max_length parameter (default 2000). 4) Return True if the assertion passes, raise an AssertionError with a descriptive message if it fails. 5) The method should handle edge cases where the text field is empty or contains special characters. 6) Log the actual character count and the maximum allowed for debugging purposes.
implementation_checklist: Call existing get_entered_text() method to retrieve current text value from 'edit_feedback' field
Store the retrieved text in a variable (e.g., entered_text)
Calculate the actual character count using len(entered_text)
Log the actual character count for debugging (e.g., using print or logger)
Log the expected_max_length parameter for debugging
Compare actual character count with expected_max_length
If assertion fails, raise AssertionError with descriptive message including actual count and max allowed
Handle edge case: if entered_text is None or empty string, log this condition
Optionally wait for 'edit_feedback_char_count' element to be visible
Optionally get text from 'edit_feedback_char_count' using self.driver.get_attribute() to verify character count display
Optionally parse the character count display text (e.g., '2000/2000' format) and validate it matches actual count
Return True if all assertions pass
